summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the new post-validation flow pages (/brand-kit, /launch-kit, /ship) plus updated landing CTAs. All routing, stepper state, cross-page navigation, outreach tab switching, copy buttons, checklist toggling/progress, journey recap rows, and 1440px + 390px responsive layout verified. 0 console errors. Two minor static-copy inconsistencies found in LaunchKit hero/tab labels.

issues: Cold tab label reads '20 Cold messages' (data-testid outreach-tab-cold) but only 10 messages exist in COLD_MESSAGES and only 10 are rendered (copy-cold-0 … copy-cold-9). Either bump COLD_MESSAGES to 20 entries or change the label to '10 Cold messages'.
Hero metric 'Outreach assets' shows '30', but the actual assets in the kit total 20 (10 cold + 5 reddit + 5 X). Adjust to '20' or add 10 more cold messages to make 30 truthful.

action_items: Reconcile cold-messages count: either change outreach-tab-cold label to '10 Cold messages' or extend COLD_MESSAGES to 20.
Reconcile hero metric 'Outreach assets' (currently 30) with actual 20 assets shipped.
critical_code_review_comments: FlowNav.jsx: currentIndex lookup {brand:3, launch:4, ship:5}[current] will be undefined if an invalid `current` prop is ever passed (no default). Minor robustness — consider falling back to 3.

CopyButton text is wrapped in Tailwind `uppercase`, so the 'Copied' affordance renders as 'COPIED'. Functionally fine, but any test (or screen-reader caption) that does a case-sensitive assertion on 'Copied' will fail — worth standardising in spec.
BrandKit.jsx, LaunchKit.jsx, Ship.jsx each re-declare an inline `Label` and `Card` component (duplicate code across 3 files). Extract to /components/flow/Primitives.jsx — minor DRY violation.

Ship.jsx progress rounding: 1/8 -> 13%, 2/8 -> 25%, 3/8 -> 38%, etc. With 8 items only checkpoints 0,13,25,38,50,63,75,88,100 are reachable — the spec example '2 of 8 = 25%' matches, just flag that no exact 12.5% step exists.
TickerBar concatenates TICKER 3x for the marquee illusion; if TICKER ever grows past ~8 items this loop becomes redundant. Not a bug, but consider computing repeats from container width.

LaunchKit OUTREACH_TABS hardcodes the label counts ('20 Cold messages', '5 Reddit posts', '5 X / Twitter hooks'). Derive counts from COLD_MESSAGES.length / REDDIT_POSTS.length / X_HOOKS.length so labels can't drift from content.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required flows pass; only static-copy nits flagged)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All three new flow pages render correctly under https://redesign-preview-44.preview.emergentagent.com/{brand-kit|launch-kit|ship}. FlowNav stepper renders done(green)/current(red) via currentIndex 3/4/5. CopyButton uses Tailwind 'uppercase' so its 'Copied' state appears as 'COPIED' in DOM — use case-insensitive assertion. Ship checklist has 8 items; progress percentages step in increments of 13/12 due to Math.round. Default outreach tab is 'cold'. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow on any of the 3 pages. Landing CTAs nav-cta / hero-primary-cta / final-cta-button all point to /brand-kit.
verified_flows: /brand-kit, /launch-kit, /ship all render brand-kit-page / launch-kit-page / ship-page testids without console errors
ticker-bar + flow-logo present on every flow page

Stepper state: /brand-kit -> Brand current(red), 3 prior steps done(green); /launch-kit -> Launch current, 4 done; /ship -> Ship current, 5 done (verified via class & count of green-bordered step containers)
FlowNav tabs flownav-landing/brand/launch/ship all navigate to correct routes
Landing CTAs nav-cta / hero-primary-cta / final-cta-button all href=/brand-kit (and final-cta-button click navigates correctly)

Outreach tabs: default cold visible with 10 copy-cold-* items; outreach-tab-reddit swaps to outreach-reddit-list with 5 items; outreach-tab-x swaps to outreach-x-list with 5 items; returning to cold restores list
Copy buttons copy-headline, copy-cold-0, copy-tagline-0, copy-beta, copy-channel-01, copy-short, copy-long all flip to 'COPIED' state on click (no thrown errors even though clipboard is sandboxed)
Ship checklist: initial progress 0% -> click item-0+item-1 -> 25% -> uncheck item-0 -> 13% -> uncheck item-1 -> 0%; green checked styling toggles correctly (class includes 32d74b)
Journey recap rows journey-validate ... journey-ship all rendered as <a> tags with hrefs
Responsive: no horizontal overflow at 1440 width on any page; at 390 width scrollWidth==390 on all 3 pages; mobile outreach tab swap also works
